name: gizza-ai/pdf-watermark
summary: Stamp a text watermark onto every page of a PDF

tool.description: Stamp a text watermark (CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT, a company name…) onto every page of a PDF. The same `text` is placed on each selected page — control the `position` (center or a corner/edge), the `rotation` in degrees (45 = classic diagonal), the `font`/`font_size`/`color`/`opacity` (faint by default), whether to `tile` it in a mosaic across the whole page, and which `pages` to mark (1-based; use '2-' to skip a cover page). Provide the PDF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

color.description: Text colour as a hex code, e.g. #808080 (grey, default), #ff0000 (red) or #f00.

font.description: Built-in font family: helvetica (sans), times (serif) or courier (mono). Default helvetica.

font_size.description: Font size in points (4–288). Watermarks are large — default 48.

opacity.description: Opacity from 0.05 (barely visible) to 1.0 (fully opaque). 0.15–0.4 reads as a subtle watermark. Default 0.3.

pages.description: Which pages to watermark, 1-based: 'all' (default), a list/range like '1,3-5', or an open range like '2-' to skip a cover page.

position.description: Where to anchor the watermark: center (default) or a corner/edge — top/middle/bottom × left/center/right. Ignored when tile is true.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise (-360 to 360). 0 = horizontal; 45 (default) or -45 gives the classic diagonal stamp; 90 = vertical.

text.description: The watermark text stamped on every selected page, e.g. 'CONFIDENTIAL', 'DRAFT' or 'Acme Corp'. Required.

tile.description: When true, repeat the watermark in a grid (mosaic) across the whole page instead of a single stamp — harder to crop out. Default false.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
